#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define INF 1e9+9
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define ppi pair<pii,int>
#define ll long long

struct Edge {
    int u, v, flow, capacity;
    Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
        this->u = u;
        this->v = v;
        this->flow = flow;
        this->capacity = capacity;
    }
};

int source, sink;
vector<vector<int>> G;
vector<Edge> e;

void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
    G[u].push_back(e.size());
    e.emplace_back(u, v, 0, capacity);
    G[v].push_back(e.size());
    e.emplace_back(v, u, 0, 0);
}

int ptr[1001];
int dist[1001];

bool findPath() {
    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
    dist[source] = 0;
    queue<int> Q;
    Q.push(source);
    while (!Q.empty()) {
        int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
        for (int i : G[u]) {
            int v = e[i].v;
            if (dist[v] == -1 && e[i].flow < e[i].capacity) {
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                Q.push(v);
                if (v == sink) return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

ll sendFlow(int u, ll flow) {
    if (flow == 0 || u == sink) return flow;
    for (; ptr[u] < G[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
        int id = G[u][ptr[u]];
        int v = e[id].v;
        if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && e[id].flow < e[id].capacity) {
            ll pushed = sendFlow(v, min(flow, (ll)(e[id].capacity - e[id].flow)));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e[id].flow += pushed;
                e[id ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

ll dinic() {
    ll totalFlow = 0;
    while (findPath()) {
        memset(ptr, 0, sizeof(ptr));
        while (ll pushed = sendFlow(source, INF))
            totalFlow += pushed;
    }
    return totalFlow;
}

string scientists[101], reactors[101];
bool reachable[10][10][10][10];
int visited[101][101];
int turnsUnusable[10][10];
int n, m;

bool valid(int r, int c) {
    return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
}

int getID(int x, int y) {
    return 1 + m * x + y;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    int T; cin >> T; T++;
    n = m; // assuming square grid
    sink = m * m * 2 + 1;
    source = 0;
    G.resize(m * m * 2 + 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> scientists[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> reactors[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            turnsUnusable[i][j] = INF;
            if (reactors[i][j] == 'Z') {
                queue<pii> q; q.push({i, j});
                turnsUnusable[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    // BFS for 'Z' cells
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (reactors[i][j] == 'Z') {
                queue<pii> q; q.push({i, j});
                while (!q.empty()) {
                    auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop();
                    for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                        for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                            if (abs(dx) + abs(dy) == 1) {
                                int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                                if (valid(nx, ny) && turnsUnusable[nx][ny] == INF && scientists[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                                    turnsUnusable[nx][ny] = turnsUnusable[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.push({nx, ny});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Build graph
    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
        for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
            if (scientists[x][y] >= '1' && scientists[x][y] <= '9')
                addEdge(source, getID(x, y), scientists[x][y] - '0');
            if (reactors[x][y] >= '1' && reactors[x][y] <= '9')
                addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, reactors[x][y] - '0');
            for (int X = 0; X < n; ++X) {
                for (int Y = 0; Y < m; ++Y) {
                    if (scientists[x][y] == 'Y' || scientists[x][y] == 'Z' || reactors[X][Y] == 'Y' || reactors[X][Y] == 'Z')
                        continue;
                    memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
                    std::queue<ppi> q; q.push({{x, y}, 1});
                    visited[x][y] = 1;
                    while (!q.empty()) {
                        auto [pos, t] = q.front(); q.pop();
                        int xx = pos.first, yy = pos.second;
                        if (xx == X && yy == Y) {
                            visited[xx][yy] = 1; break;
                        }
                        if (t >= turnsUnusable[xx][yy] || t >= T) continue;
                        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                                if (abs(dx) + abs(dy) == 1) {
                                    int nx = xx + dx, ny = yy + dy;
                                    if (valid(nx, ny) && !visited[nx][ny] && scientists[nx][ny] != 'Y' && scientists[nx][ny] != 'Z' && t + 1 <= turnsUnusable[nx][ny]) {
                                        visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                        q.push({{nx, ny}, t + 1});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (visited[X][Y]) {
                        addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ll maxFlow = dinic();
    std::cout << maxFlow << "\n";
    return 0;
}
